ruleDefinitions.name: Indirect Command Execution From Script File Via Bash.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher without any flags to execute the content of a bash script directly.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\bash\\\.exe$")) OR process_original_file_name = "Bash\.exe") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*bash\\\.exe\\ \\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bash\\ \\-.*")) OR process_command_line = "None" OR process_command_line = "" OR (process_command_line = "bash\.exe" OR process_command_line = "bash"))
